title: PR Review Loop reviewer output
description: Strict JSON contract for one reviewer subagent's output, validated by scripts/validate_reviewer_output.py at the start of §4c synthesize. Schema version is encoded in $id; bump when changing the contract.

reviewer.description: Persona name, matching the filename in reviewers/ without the .md extension. This enum is generated from reviewers/personas.yaml; regenerate via scripts/regen.sh.

finding_evidence.description: Per-finding evidence pointer read by scripts/promote_findings.py for evidence-gated solo-adversary promotion. Distinct from the top-level reviewer `evidence` object, which feeds shallow-review detection only.

move_b_pattern.description: Set by Move B (second-instance sweep) findings to name the syntactically findable pattern in one phrase. Presence signals Move B ran for this finding and is recorded on the iteration history entry for post-hoc audit. See SKILL.md §4b.

move_a1_pattern.description: Set by Move A.1 (assertion-vacuity audit) findings to name the specific sub-mechanic the assertion exhibits. One of the named patterns per reviewers/tests.md. Distinct from move_b_pattern; an assertion-vacuity finding from Move A.1 sets move_a1_pattern, not move_b_pattern. See reviewers/tests.md and SKILL.md §4b.

evidence.description: Optional record of what the reviewer read/traced before judging. Personas SHOULD populate this; the schema does not require it (verdict=request_changes and verdict=comment are valid with no evidence). Downstream enforcement: scripts/flag_shallow_reviews.py records a shallow_review flag for any reviewer that returned verdict=approve with missing or empty evidence.files_read (the flag affects synthesis routing in §4c, not schema validity). See SKILL.md §4b.
